domestic_evidence: Company investor page (pricol.com/investors), FY2026 consolidated performance highlights: "4,052.37 Total Income" (₹ crore, consolidated), "492.91 EBITDA", "330.94 Profit Before Tax", "250.80 Profit After Tax"; listed on NSE (PRICOLLTD.NS) and BSE (PRICOLLTD.BO). Domestic Indian OEM supply (driver-information/connected-vehicle clusters, actuation and fluid-management systems) is evidenced by this audited-scale consolidated turnover and listed-company status; the exact domestic-vs-export revenue split and GST turnover band are not shown on the public page — null, not public in what was read.
note: Legal entity exists and is actively trading: real, dated export shipments to Germany (Hamburg) with HS 84133020 and B/L numbers 1130459/1130446 dated 2026-02-28, plus import flows of PCBs (HS 85340000) from group entity Pricol Asia Pte Ltd, Taiwan→Chennai. Declared HS codes 852692;870899 do not match the observed records — actual codes seen are 84133020 (oil/water pump assemblies) and 85340000 (printed circuit boards); per project rule the company is retained and the HS code should be corrected to the factual one (accepted_hs_corrected), not rejected. Industry claim 'IT и электроника' is only partly right: the company is primarily an automotive components maker (mechanical products/motor vehicle parts) that also handles PCB assemblies. Consolidated total income ₹4,052.37 Cr (FY2026) is from the company's own investor page, not independently audited here. Volza and Eximpedia free views returned HTTP 403, so ImportKey was the only shipment source actually read; no second-source cross-check of individual B/Ls was possible.
